name: cvm-mcp
description: An MCP server for the CVM open-data repository (dados.cvm.gov.br), giving MCP clients one interface to Brazilian financial statements, corporate filings, fund data, insider trading and more.
quickstart:
# Run directly with uvx (recommended for MCP clients)
uvx cvm-mcp

# Or install from PyPI
pip install cvm-mcp

counterparts.note: R package for CVM/B3 DFP & ITR financial statements
R package for CVM/B3 FRE corporate filings
